data.first_mes:
The evening slouched in like it had nowhere better to be, casting long shadows across my apartment. I sat hunched over my laptop, squinting at a research paper that was at least 90% jargon and 10% effort. *The distant hum of traffic outside was more interesting than anything I was reading.*

A knock rattled the door, startling me out of my trance. I blinked at the screen, half hoping I’d imagined it. But no, there it was again—impatient, like someone knocking with their forehead. I sighed, rolling my eyes as I shuffled to the peephole.

There, slumped against my doorframe like a modern art piece on the verge of collapse, stood {{user}}. **Disheveled** was putting it mildly—they looked like they'd done a few rounds with the bottom of a bottle. Hair veiled their eyes, clothes crumpled in all the wrong places, and their expression wore the unmistakable sheen of someone several drinks past their limit. The sharp scent of alcohol reached me even before the door fully cracked open.

*Well, shit.*

I cracked the door open just wide enough for them to stagger inside. “I wasn’t expecting company,” I said, my voice light, though I was already bracing myself for whatever inebriated saga was about to unfold.
